authority.note: Sealed BEFORE either arm's holdout contrast was computed (P-EVID-01). Sparse independent signal = causal SEM-026 mother inside-close entries; FM-054 agree is a magnitude/time prior (SEM-028), not the entry. y_mfe_r / y_time_to_mfe are path labels, not book PnL. economic_claims_allowed stays false until mt00==PASS and mt01_matrix_coverage==COMPLETE. P-GOAL-04 is not opened. A diagnostic sign-match is NOT G001.

population.inclusion_rule: MEASUREMENT CORPUS = data/mt5/XAUUSD_M15.csv ONLY (47275 bars, sha256 4d73f5cebe33ec91c5312340337eb62c2cf1f49060c91c42761bf631b26aba56). SPARSE SIGNAL POPULATION = causal SEM-026 detect_inside_close_entries(bars), each entry e resolved to its clean label row (decision_ts = test.last_ts, side = e.direction) from results/clean_labels/XAUUSD/20260723T083443Z/clean_labels (TN_ENV_CLEAN_L2). One unit = one such (entry_ts, direction) row with finite y_mfe_r and trend_bias in {+1,-1}. SUCCESS GATE uses HOLDOUT units only (entry_ts >= 2025-12-24 19:15:00).
population.exclusion_rule: EXCLUDED: the every-bar x side clean_labels grain (that is SEM-028/SEM-029, and F-086 showed it structurally losing); the SEM-026 trade ledger (no walk, no SL/TP here); the CRT spine events/telemetry run (a different grain, not 1:1 joinable); opportunities.outcome (F-022). trend_bias=0 rows dropped from PRIMARY. F-086 236-bar stride holdout is NOT this split and remains unspent. Hour-of-day and session cells are OUT OF PATH for the success gate (F-066).

features.point_in_time_rule: Sparse signal (SEM-026) is computed from only bars at or before the test-block last close (causal). trend_bias (FM-054) is the stored t=0 ternary on that bar. y_mfe_r and y_time_to_mfe use path labels after t, which is the object (information in the subsequent path of a given side), not a t=0 tradable size knob. F-051 centered-swing declared: PRIMARY uses only FM-054 sign. F-066 session/hour OUT OF PATH for the gate.

sparse_signal.formula_ref: detect_inside_close_entries(bars) one (entry_ts, direction) per causal mother inside-close

forbidden_aliases: SEM-026 ledger matcher as this signal
SEM-029 overlay k as this y

labels.y_definition: Arm S: y = clean_labels y_mfe_r on the sparse entry's (entry_ts, direction) row (TN_ENV_CLEAN_L2 horizon_excursion, exit-agnostic, max_forward=40). Arm T: y = y_time_to_mfe on that row (bars until primary-path MFE first attained; nulls dropped). NOT stream mfe, NOT y_tp1, NOT y_R_net, NOT SEM-027 ΔMFE.
labels.sign_convention: Positive contrast_S means the agreeing sparse entry printed more MFE than the disagreeing entry. Positive contrast_T means the agreeing entry took more bars to print its MFE.

components.name: not_a_trade
components.bps_or_formula: y_mfe_r / y_time_to_mfe are not book PnL. No spread, commission, or slippage is applied. SEM-015 is OUT OF PATH. A later size overlay on y_R_net is a different MC-*.

exits.intrabar_rule: Inherited from the sealed clean_labels protocol (horizon_excursion, exit-agnostic). This experiment does not re-walk SL/TP. It does not use opportunities.outcome.
not_equal_to: forward_walk net R as this y
SEM-026 ledger SL/TP walk as this y

splits.embargo: 96 M15 bars between last train entry and first holdout entry
splits.purge: drop train entries whose 40-bar label horizon overlaps holdout start
splits.oos_fraction_or_dates: last 20% of corpus bars by index; first holdout entry timestamp 2025-12-24 19:15:00 (idx 37820). Identical calendar to MC-MRANGE/MC-ASYM/MC-MAGPRIOR. F-086 stride holdout of 236 bars is a different split and is not spent.

metrics.success_gate: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, PER ARM. For each arm: holdout both agree/disagree cells n>=30 AND sign(holdout contrast)==sign(train contrast). Meeting a clause is NOT economic validation while economic_claims_allowed is false. Session and hour cells are never gated. Passing S does not pass T.
metrics.kill_criteria: Any outcome including n=0 or n<30 is registered. Changing y, the sparse signal definition, the agree rule, holdout date, embargo, or purge after seeing holdout y requires a NEW MC-* id. Do not promote session/hour into PRIMARY. Do not turn this into a side picker. Do not add a one-open trade suppression after seeing y.

pipeline_identity.config_version_source: NOT the production config path. Object frozen in docs/research/mother_range_prior_object.md. ACTIVE_VERSION is never written.

Use opportunities.outcome, stream mfe, y_R_net, or SEM-027 ΔMFE as this y
Treat y_mfe_r as net expectancy or apply 12bps as if this were a trade book
Substitute y_tp1, the SEM-026 SL/TP walk, or a new SL/TP walk for stored horizon_excursion labels

Present diagnostic sign-match as G001, wire the other arm's sign after seeing holdout, add a one-open suppression after seeing y, or treat this as a side picker

Use hour_of_day, session, or trend_strength as the PRIMARY state; use trend_bias to choose side; substitute the every-bar grain for the sparse signal
